---
name: feature-design
description: When thinking about, planning or designing a new feature in the app, or conducting any ui edits, this skill should be used to ensure a user-friendly and intuitive design.
---

- Make sure to think about the UI, Keep it super simple and intuitive, minimalistic design
- Use Tailwindcss for styling, follow the existing design patterns in the app
- Think about the user experience
- Ask questions about the feature to be created

Ask at least 3 clarifying questions to ensure you fully understand the requirements and expectations for the new feature
BEFORE creating any file or performing any actions
